w: Swamishri performs murti pratishtha in the newly constructed Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Kavitha, and also inaugurates a Computer Center.
Swamishri inaugurates a playground for children.
The murti of Harikrishna Maharaj is honored in an evening assembly.

ph: Inaugurates a Computer Center in the Mandir complex

w: Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of murtis for the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Sansoli.

A devotee expressed his brother’s woes before Swamishri. He said that his brother, who was present with him, and brother-in-law had jointly started a business. Later, due to personal differences the business did not take off well. His brother lost his capital investment and his relationship with his brother-in-law broke down. Both were no longer on talking terms with each other. The brother cried on remembering his loss. Swamishri explained to the devotee’s brother, “The more you harbour bitterness and pain, the more you will be at loss. Forget whatever that has happened. As long as there is bitterness between you, both of you will be miserable. Shedding tears will not bring anything back. You will get peace by believing that it was God’s wish. You have to start talking to him. If there is unity then you will regain your wealth soon. Now forget that it was he who had caused a loss to you. If any loss by him was fated due to God’s wish, then it has happened. Learn to be happy with this understanding.” Swamishri gently, and with loving advice and understanding eased the bitter pain in the young man’s mind.

Today, after finishing breakfast, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was entering his room, he himself lifted the hook like stopper at the bottom of the door with the big toe and first toe of his right foot, because it was sticking out slightly. Swamishri had thought, "What if someone coming behind knocks their foot on it and gets hurt?"
This action of his made everyone understand: "Swamishri cares for us at every step. He keeps removing the obstacles that come in our path. If we walk in his footsteps, no obstacle can trouble us."

During today's meetings, a seeker named Sukhabhai came. Introducing him, the sadhus said to Mahant Swami Maharaj, "He is a very dedicated devotee of ours. He has spread satsang in 70 villages of Mahuva taluka...!"
Hearing this much, Swamishri began to introduce him further, saying, "An Ahir... he ran a campaign for ghar sabhas (family assemblies)..."
Swamishri recalled exactly something from years ago! Sukhabhai, at the very thought, "How closely Swamishri knows me!", was experiencing boundless joy
In today's series of meetings, a satsangi named Rajeshbhai Patel came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. As soon as he saw him, Swamishri said, "Red car..."
Hearing this, the sadhus asked, "What is this?"

Then Rajeshbhai explained, "In 1959, when Swamishri came to Zambia with Yogibapa as Vinu Bhagat, my uncle Dhansukhbhai drove him around in a red car. Swamishri recalled that today..." All who heard this were absorbed in Swamishri's sharp intellect and his affection for devotees.

Today, after walking round the assembly hall, as he was returning, Mahant Swami Maharaj said in the lift, "Every day one round is completed in one and a quarter minutes. Today it took one and a half minutes."

Shrutipriyadas Swami said in surprise, "Swami! You said it exactly without a timer! And what is more, how much you do at the same time! You keep having darshan of the murtis installed in the assembly hall, you keep meeting the eyes of the sadhus and saying 'Divine... divine...', and of course you observe everything around. Along with all that you also measured the exact time."
Swamishri laughed and said, "Many things can be known even without measuring."
